mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets ( user_id, name, weight, breed, sex, is_neutered, `size`, birth_year, memo ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{weight}, #{breed}, #{sex}, #{isNeutered}, #{size}, #{birthYear}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT pet_id, user_id, name, weight, breed, sex, is_neutered, `size`, birth_year, memo, created_at, updated_at FROM pets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
